mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix allows Alloy to choose any Allowed relation, including AuditOfficer→RecordsLookup; the injected fact forces exactly that forbidden cell, which LeastPrivilege must then catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrix { AuditOfficer -> RecordsLookup in PermMatrix.Allowed and (some a: RecordAccessAttempt | a.caller.role = AuditOfficer and a.outcome = Permitted) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamGating removes the bidirectional care-team constraint; the injection forces a Permitted outcome for a caller who has no ActiveMembership, proving a break-glass path could exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGating { some a: RecordAccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and (no m: ActiveMembership | m.member = a.caller) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditOneToOne removes the bijection between AuditEntry and RecordAccessAttempt; the injection creates two AuditEntries that share the same records link, violating both completeness (a second write counts as a mutation) and injectivity.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditOneToOne { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.records = ae2.records }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AttributionCorrect allows a role snapshot that differs from the caller's actual role; the injection forces one such mismatch, which AttributionCorrectness must detect.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionCorrect { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.roleSnapshot != ae.records.caller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ByteEquivalentResponse permits Denied or NotFoundOrDenied outcomes to carry a PermittedResponse shape; the injection forces exactly this, letting an observer distinguish a denied patient from a non-existent one.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ByteEquivalentResponse { some a: RecordAccessAttempt | a.outcome = Denied and a.extResponse = PermittedResponse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditSearchGating removes the AuditOfficer-only constraint on audit search; the injection places a Doctor as the searcher of an AuditSearchAttempt, which FR_011_AuditIGOnly must flag.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditSearchGating { some s: AuditSearchAttempt | s.searcher.role = Doctor }
